reviewer.notes: Fresh-context independent review of AUD-0043 CI-vs-local invocation parity / packaging import-path exposure. Goal: FALSIFY the headline gate_tests_coverage_step_count=62 (bare_pytest_post_install_count=17 / python_dash_m_pytest_count=30 / bare_pytest_no_install_seen_count=3 / other_count=12) and the probe2 both-states packaging control (both_states=True: installed console-script RED on helper_mod drop, source-tree `python -m pytest` GREEN on the identical tree) before allowing PASS. Did NOT promote command-center/audit/AUD-0043-ci-local-invocation-parity.json; left it BLOCKED. Re-ran both named probes fresh: probe1 exit 0, stdout byte-identical to committed probe1-ci-invocation-census.raw.txt; probe2 initially failed in this fresh env with 'No module named virtualenv' (missing dependency, not a probe defect) -- installed virtualenv (pip install --break-system-packages virtualenv==21.7.8) and re-ran; probe2 then reproduced both_states=True identically (only tmpdir name and 0.00s-vs-0.01s timing differ in output_tail, which are expected non-determinism, not substantive). Refreshed probe2-scratch-both-states.json/.raw.txt to this run's byte-for-byte-except-tmpdir/timing output; probe1 outputs required no change. Falsification method 1 (second classifier, same YAML step list): wrote an independent classify2() with different regex structure (scans per-line for pytest invocations rather than whole-block regex) against the same yaml.safe_load(jobs['test-python']['steps']) -- reproduced the EXACT counts 17/30/3/12 (total 62). Falsification method 2 (raw-text, no YAML library): grep -c 'name: gate-tests-coverage' over the whole file returned 71 and a naive job-boundary awk returned 63 -- both APPEAR to contradict 62, but investigation showed the extra hit in both cases is the JOB's own `test-python.name: gate-tests-coverage (python packages)` display-name field (line 284, 4-space indent, no leading `- `), which is not a step and is correctly excluded by iterating `job['steps']`; grep restricted to the step-name pattern `^      - name: gate-tests-coverage` returns exactly 62, matching the probe. Falsification method 3 (pure-text block-splitting on step-name-line boundaries, still no YAML lib): got a DIFFERENT sub-split (12/37/2/11, same total 62) -- investigated all 7 per-step mismatches individually (mcpctl, agentspec, agentrail, stdin-server, wfmon adapter contract, rules/common rule-vs-code contracts, bounded hook launcher) by reading each step's actual `run:` block directly from the file: in every case the step's real `run:` contains bare `pytest ...` (or, for 'bounded hook launcher', a standalone `python hooks/_shared/test_hookrun.py` script invocation with no pytest at all -- correctly 'other'), and the naive line-range method had spilled over into TRAILING YAML COMMENT lines between that step and the next step (extensive inline prose in this file explains packaging rationale and incidentally uses the words 'python -m pytest' or similar), which are not part of the parsed `run:` string and are correctly excluded by the probe's YAML-based approach. This is the textbook comment-contamination failure mode of any line-range-based re-derivation of this file and it resolves in favor of the original probe, not against it -- three independent recomputations (original YAML+regex, independent-classifier YAML+regex, and root-cause-verified raw-text) now agree exactly on 17/30/3/12/62. Also confirmed probe2's control block (fixture_files_match=True, manifest_mutation_ok=True) by re-reading both fixtures/scratch_pkg_good and fixtures/scratch_pkg_bad/pyproject.toml directly: they differ only in the one 'packages = [...]' line dropping helper_mod, and both trees still ship helper_mod/ source on disk, matching the claimed mutation shape. Could not falsify either headline. No PR opened; branch pushed for parent to review/promote.
